FOR YOU

Know your rights. Level up.

Ask in your own words. No account, no judgement, and nothing you type is saved to your name.

Start learningTalk to a person
🧑

The police want me to come down the station. Do I go alone?

⚖️

No. You can get free legal advice, and if you’re under 18 an adult has to be with you.

⚖️ Free legal advice at the station

What can you ask about?

🏠 First home

Deposits, contracts, and what to do if things go wrong.

💼 First job

Pay, hours, and what your boss can’t do.

📱 Online life

Shared photos, scams, and threats.

👮 Police and school

Your rights if you’re stopped, questioned or excluded.
